who.value: seller with a multi-lot Live order

job.value: check the order and ship it

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Order details' with 'Ship out by 17 Apr' and buyer details says what this is.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'Ship order' is the strongest element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Ship order', 'Copy' and 'View profile' predict their result.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Carousell official delivery' and 'Pick-up or drop off' are familiar to a seller.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Shipping is a decision the seller can make now.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Lot details follow below and earnings sit further down.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything belongs to fulfilling the order.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The status card repeats the CTA in a three-line sentence ('Tap 'Ship order' to choose…'), though the deadline headline carries it.
